callouts.label: Crop
callouts.hint: Orange scissors cutting a small picture, top center.
callouts.description: Cuts the chosen rectangle out of the still picture.

callouts.label: Global hotkey
callouts.hint: Three blank purple keycaps, upper right.
callouts.description: Listens for Control-Shift-4 from any application and starts a grab.

callouts.label: Screen freeze
callouts.hint: Ice-blue monitor with a snowflake, right side.
callouts.description: Captures the whole screen as a still picture at the moment of the grab.

callouts.label: Clipboard
callouts.hint: Teal clipboard holding a small picture, lower right.
callouts.description: Receives the cropped image so that it can be pasted.

callouts.label: Permission check
callouts.hint: Green shield with a keyhole, lower left.
callouts.description: Confirms that screen recording permission has been granted; if not, tells the user what to change.

callouts.label: Selection overlay
callouts.hint: Dimmed monitor with a bright dashed rectangle and a mouse pointer, left side.
callouts.description: Shows the still picture and lets the user drag a rectangle over it.

callouts.label: Menu bar item
callouts.hint: Gold bar with a small round icon and a drop-down panel, upper left.
callouts.description: Shows the icon in the menu bar and offers a menu command that starts a grab; it does not capture anything itself.

trace.question: What happens first when the user presses the hotkey?
trace.why: Nothing can be captured until permission is confirmed.

trace.question: Permission is confirmed. Which component runs next?
trace.why: With permission confirmed, the whole screen is captured as a still.

trace.question: The screen has been captured. Which component runs next?
trace.why: The still picture is displayed so the user can drag over it.

trace.question: The user has dragged a rectangle. Which component runs next?
trace.why: The chosen rectangle is cut from the still picture.

trace.question: The rectangle has been cut out. Which component runs next?
trace.why: The cropped image is delivered to the clipboard.

trace.question: Now the user starts a grab from the menu instead. Which component runs next?
trace.why: The menu command starts the same path, so it also goes through the permission check first.
